reason: This is not a narrow DDL-only cleanup: it changes the add-index/backfill path across `pkg/table`, `pkg/tablecodec`, `pkg/executor`, and mockstore MVCC. Even though the stated goal is efficiency, these paths are tightly tied to index key encoding, duplicate checking, backfill correctness, and admin/index validation, so regressions here can become high-severity table/storage consistency bugs.
